answer: I did not submit a job. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot run on garnet. I checked the live garnet backend and it reports 20 qubits, and the docs also list it as Crystal 20. The circuit would fail to transpile, so submitting it would waste credits and return no counts. Two options would work. One is a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet. The other is a 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits. Emerald costs more credits, and Starter access to it is not confirmed.
